relocation_line: I will relocate to Toowoomba for this role and can start two weeks after an offer.
cover_letter_text:
Hi PCP Solutions team,

I'm Marc, and I'd like to apply for your Graduate Civil Engineer role in Toowoomba. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019), and I graduated in February 2026 with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design. The role works under experienced project managers and site engineers, and that's how I'd like to start out.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I was on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge and then field engineer. I carried out inspections and quality checks, reviewed drawings and wrote the progress reports. For the diploma I designed roads, earthworks and drainage and prepared bills of quantities.

I'm happy to move to Toowoomba and can start two weeks after an offer. I hold a White Card and a driver's licence, and I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Happy to chat whenever suits.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
